name: SpaceMapper AOE Source
description: Read SpaceMapper's AOE catalog records (its SGP4 two-line sets, the NORAD number it gives or aoe:<id>, the channel) into canonical SDS $OMM records, an id crosswalk of candidate identities as $CAT records and the batch's IngestRequest (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only). Input: one HttpResponse (HRSP) whose BODY is the records the host extracted from SpaceMapper's pages, verbatim (JSON lines or one JSON array, at most 128 MiB); 304 -> one FlowNotice Unchanged; any other non-200 fails. Retrieval and page decoding belong to the SDN host flow. No hostcalls, no capabilities.

methods.displayName: Read AOE element sets as OMM

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpResponse (HRSP): STATUS, URL (the source, echoed into the meta), RETRIEVED_MS, BODY the AOE records verbatim as the host extracted them from SpaceMapper's pages: JSON lines (one object per element set, as the archive's records.jsonl) or one JSON array of objects, at most 128 MiB. CONTEXT is not read.

inputPorts.description: HttpResponse (HRSP): STATUS, URL (the source, echoed into the meta), RETRIEVED_MS, BODY the AOE records verbatim as the host extracted them from SpaceMapper's pages: JSON lines (one object per element set, as the archive's records.jsonl) or one JSON array of objects, at most 128 MiB. CONTEXT is not read.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Canonical size-prefixed OMM records in input order, one per element set that could be read, without padding between them.

outputPorts.description: Canonical size-prefixed OMM records in input order, one per element set that could be read, without padding between them.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Size-prefixed $CAT records, one per AOE object (in AOE id order), what AOE states about it from its newest set, as candidates: CATALOG_URI urn:sdn:spacemapper-aoe and CATALOG_OBJECT_ID aoe:<id> (AOE's own namespace), NORAD_CAT_ID the number AOE gives (0 for none), OBJECT_ID the designator it gives, OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_TYPE (PAYLOAD, ROCKET BODY, DEBRIS, else UNKNOWN). Identity evidence for the $CAT integrator, never an assertion; channel, satellite id and AOE's object type text ride on the $OMM USER_DEFINED_PARAMETERS.

outputPorts.description: Size-prefixed $CAT records, one per AOE object (in AOE id order), what AOE states about it from its newest set, as candidates: CATALOG_URI urn:sdn:spacemapper-aoe and CATALOG_OBJECT_ID aoe:<id> (AOE's own namespace), NORAD_CAT_ID the number AOE gives (0 for none), OBJECT_ID the designator it gives, OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_TYPE (PAYLOAD, ROCKET BODY, DEBRIS, else UNKNOWN). Identity evidence for the $CAT integrator, never an assertion; channel, satellite id and AOE's object type text ride on the $OMM USER_DEFINED_PARAMETERS.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One IngestRequest (INGQ): SCHEMA OMM.fbs, TAGS SOURCE_NAME spacemapper-aoe, SOURCE_URL the response URL, BATCH_ID the SHA-256 of the body; PROVENANCE PARSER spacemapper-aoe-source, SOURCE_SHA256, NORMALIZED_COUNT (OMM records), SCHEMAS/SCHEMA_COUNTS (OMM.fbs, CAT.fbs), ATTRIBUTES the counts (records, emitted, duplicateRecordIds, rejected, rejection:<reason>, alpha5CatalogNumbers, checksumMismatches, withoutNoradNumber, objects), WARNINGS the first 20 rejected records with their reasons and the AOE ids whose sets conflict.

outputPorts.description: One IngestRequest (INGQ): SCHEMA OMM.fbs, TAGS SOURCE_NAME spacemapper-aoe, SOURCE_URL the response URL, BATCH_ID the SHA-256 of the body; PROVENANCE PARSER spacemapper-aoe-source, SOURCE_SHA256, NORMALIZED_COUNT (OMM records), SCHEMAS/SCHEMA_COUNTS (OMM.fbs, CAT.fbs), ATTRIBUTES the counts (records, emitted, duplicateRecordIds, rejected, rejection:<reason>, alpha5CatalogNumbers, checksumMismatches, withoutNoradNumber, objects), WARNINGS the first 20 rejected records with their reasons and the AOE ids whose sets conflict.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One FlowNotice Unchanged (REASON not-modified) when the response is a 304; nothing else is emitted then.

outputPorts.description: One FlowNotice Unchanged (REASON not-modified) when the response is a 304; nothing else is emitted then.

sequentialJustification.detail: One complete bounded set of provider records is read in input order into canonical records, candidate catalog identities and one ingest request; the host parallelizes independent snapshots and this parser creates no threads.
